methods.label: Use the distributive law in reverse
methods.explanation: Apply the distributive law in reverse to factor out the common factor: \((-5/9)\times[13+(-4)]=(-5/9)\times9=-5\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 numerical distributive law, rational addition, and rational multiplication.
